dispositions.topic_text: Base directory used to compute PhotoPlacement.name
dispositions.what: PhotoPlacement.name is relative to the photo folder with / separators, as M02 states for a scan name. Write this in the model closure.

dispositions.topic_text: Quantity and unit recorded by PhotoPlacement.size
dispositions.what: PhotoPlacement.size is the length of the stored image in bytes. Write this in the model closure.
